recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless the work group later chooses to add stronger conformance requirements for server handling of accepted versioned notification requests.
issue_request: FHIR-38997 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 clarification asking Subscription.contentType to describe use of the FHIR Version Parameter so servers can support notifications encoded for earlier FHIR versions when accepted.
initial_application: Commit 9ad46a282a55e869b5ba8efc1809297014f8f42b applied the issue directly by updating source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml to reference the MIME FHIR version parameter and provide an application/fhir+json; fhirVersion=4.0 example. Commit 3ac2ff4077fa0226baf14e3fc7db758a6d7ad365 later propagated the wording into the checked-in Subscription SVG.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists subscription=Subscription, so the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-10-31 record the 11-0-0 Persuasive motion. The preceding Zulip subscription backport thread discussed using Subscription.contentType with fhirVersion MIME parameters for R4/R4B-compatible notifications. Jira and source-history searches found no later conflicting Subscription.contentType version-parameter decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Subscription.contentType definition already tells clients they may request notifications in a specific FHIR version by using the FHIR Version Parameter and includes a concrete fhirVersion example.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same Zulip backport discussion, but it concerns the R4 subscriptions backport IG rather than the core Subscription.contentType clarification.
